sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
Our order history for this part shows 4.12 EUR (po:4500010043-10) against 4.39 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014467-10).
Your own quotation for this part offered 4.39 EUR (quote:7300004).
Today you supply 70 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 36-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
A few words on this from our side.
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We are pleased to accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms.
As a matter of company policy, we do not provide detailed cost breakdowns, but our pricing accurately reflects current market conditions.
Based on these terms and your commitment to a volume of 20,000 pieces per year, we can offer a unit price of €4.91.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €4.91 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (2)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
To substantiate our volume commitment: our official forecast fc:360020@2026-09 shows 28600 pcs per year, +4.2% against the previous plan. The attached forecast-plan.csv lists the monthly demand plan we release to our suppliers.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 36 months.
Could your commercial manager review and approve your best price on the attached terms, including our stated binding volume commitment?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We have reviewed your updated volume forecast and discussed your request with our commercial management.
While we appreciate the volume commitment, it does not change our calculation or allow for further price reductions.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
